description: Canonical machine-readable route contract for the browser-only migration (B01). Derived by reading wavefinity_web.py, organizer_drawer, organizer_spaces and the web/ callers. Every route has exactly one owner.

extra_entry_fields.source: module:line of the handler definition at the baseline head (lookup hint, not ownership of the whole function)
extra_entry_fields.browser_module: planned browser-edition module that exports the route
extra_entry_fields.wrappers: wrappers applied in wavefinity_web.py: grid_entry_guard (_grid_entry_route), idempotent_operation (_idempotent_operation: accepts operation_id), printer_output_route (_printer_output_route: adds printer_fit)
extra_entry_fields.callers: literal frontend call sites at the baseline head (api/apiSideEffect/fetch)
extra_entry_fields.additional_methods: other HTTP methods the same path answers at the baseline head
extra_entry_fields.replacement: local replacement for a retired route

conventions.request: POST application/json (<=25,000,000 bytes) unless method says GET. Same-origin only (Origin must equal Host, else 403 PermissionError). Field lists are the keys the handler reads (the hosted/local twins share one list; local-only fields are output/space_id/slicer_path, hosted-only are inventory_text/inventory_title/available_filenames/printer_profile).

error_shape.status: 400 for KeyError/TypeError/ValueError/JSONDecodeError, 404 unknown route, 403 cross-origin, 500 otherwise; /api/suggestions uses its own {error} bodies (400/403/429/502/503)

conventions.idempotency: Routes with wrapper idempotent_operation run at most once per client operation_id (<=128 chars); a repeat returns the stored result/error or {operation_id, operation_status:'running', elapsed_s, progress}; poll /api/operation-status.
conventions.hosted_vs_local: HOSTED is a server deployment flag in wavefinity_web.py. space_routes() is registered only when not HOSTED, but the browser edition needs those operations (B09).
conventions.static_paths: Non-API static paths (/, web assets, /images/*, /Brochure.md, /brochure.md) are not routes in this manifest; see the source-route index.

effects: Explicit user action sends the prompt directly to the chosen HTTPS provider with a session-memory key. Redirects, same-site/Wavefinity endpoints and untrusted custom origins are rejected; no proxy.
Local shared canonical AI logic. Saved folder snapshots establish Space authority; no HTTP server, filesystem paths or writes. Candidate proof uses the B05 canonical preview and Space-cap validation.
Status/save/clear stay local. Save persists named non-secret settings only; test explicitly contacts the provider. Clear/reload/pagehide discard the session key.
Local shared canonical AI logic. Saved folder snapshots establish Space authority; no HTTP server, filesystem paths or writes. Candidate proof uses the B05 canonical preview and Space-cap validation.
Pure: builds a repair prompt from request_id, context_fingerprint, response and error.
Native folder chooser (tkinter subprocess); never creates Documents/Wavefinity or any root; returns {folder} ('' on cancel).
Raises ValueError in HOSTED mode (the native/server operation is unavailable there).
Browser edition replaces it with the File System Access directory picker.
Return an honest browser capability notice; no executable picker/launch. Print remains the B08 handoff.
Read-only: serves static rules/defaults/platform catalog (grids, drawer/pegboard/item/text/wall/base/stack/lid rules, defaults, connector rules, preferences, slicer detection).
Local mode also reads saved preferences and detects the slicer executable; HOSTED mode returns empty preferences and no slicer.
Generates side-connector 3MF files (connector_payload); on a later partial failure returns completed files with partial/partial_stage/error instead of hiding them.
Local: writes into output. HOSTED: files exposed through /api/export tokens (retired).
Pure: reports which of one divider's labels are too long for their compartment.
Pure: builds the planning record Space shows for the design being edited.

Pure. Entry guard: rejects a client-supplied source_space, resolves the destination Space from stored records (never a client Space object), verifies source row ownership and design grid, refuses saved records lacking the 7 mm module marker (OLD_MODULE_NOTICE), then canonicalizes via validate_design_payload (Base Trim or bin design_to_dict).
Never rewrites an Inventory or folder.
Generates the drawer's required connector files (hosted: temp dir, files_base64; local: into output folder) from the supplied layout/bins.
Duplicates one design-source row (new id, unique name) in the Inventory.
Canonicalizes one editable design (design_source_payload) and saves it as a row (new or row_id); local mode queues a delayed background bin-file build.
Entry-guarded, idempotent; hosted adds build_needed.
Changes a row's status by action (e.g. Printed/Saved), checking the expected design and file cell; hosted may use available_filenames as the folder snapshot (omitted vs [] kept distinct).
HOSTED only (raises otherwise): builds one row's 3MF files in a temp dir, verifies the design still equals the saved spec, returns files_base64 keyed by file name and the comma-joined file cell.
Entry-guarded and printer-profile-wrapped.

Loads the Inventory (hosted: parse inventory_text, inferring a lossy layout.space when absent and flagging space_inferred; local: reads output folder) and adds stack_steps, stack_metrics, storage_box_headroom_default_mm.
Local only: waits for background bin builds, prepares the selected bins (generating from design specs when needed), optionally includes connectors, launches the slicer once and marks Printed.
Raises in HOSTED mode. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Raises ValueError in HOSTED mode (hosted saves files instead of opening a local slicer).

Local complete-Space handoff under one preflight and ONE slicer launch: slicer preflight, blocking-problem check, bin files (generated only when missing), placed spacer files already on disk, required connectors; marks rows Printed only after the slicer opens.
Partial outcomes return partial/partial_stage/error. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Local only: sends the selected spacer files to the slicer (all-or-nothing preflight of file existence, slicer and printer fit).
Raises in HOSTED mode. Idempotent.
Pure: drawer placement report (problems, fill, connectors, height issues, stacks, planning heights) over the supplied layout and bins.

Merges bin_updates/new_bins/new_bin_specs/delete_ids/layout into the Inventory (hosted returns the new inventory_text and cleanup_files; local writes the folder atomically and may report cleanup_failed).
Entry-guarded, idempotent per operation_id.
Local only: waits for background builds then writes the selected bins' files (and optionally connectors) into the folder.
Raises in HOSTED mode. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Read-only: plans spacers for a drawer (plan_spacers) and returns the plan with plan_signature.
Rejects a stale plan_signature, generates selected spacer 3MF files (local: into the folder; hosted: temp dir, returned as files_base64), adds spacer rows and placements in one Inventory commit.
Replaces the active drawer's spacer set in ONE Inventory commit: regenerates selected spacers and removes the old ones; reports removed count and cleanup failures.
Read-only: plans Fill Empty Space candidates for the Surface (signature + candidates).
Re-plans, rejects a stale signature/selection, then adds starter bins (design specs + placements) for the selected candidates in one Inventory commit; returns created ids.
Legacy: one-time download of a temporary generated file from the in-memory EXPORTS ledger (TTL 15 minutes; basename-only names; file removed after fetch); sends Content-Disposition attachment.
Retired: the browser edition has no server and registers no handler for this route.
routes.replacement: Transferable buffers returned by the worker and local Blob file IDs ([{name, local_file_id}] descriptors) claimed/discarded through LocalFileStore.

effects: Pure: inserts/updates a feature in the returned design, with selected index and warnings.
Pure: builds the default feature for a kind/item with resolved options and divider cells.
Pure: removes one feature from the returned design.
Pure: normalizes a draft feature against the design; may return {superseded:true} when a newer client_id/generation request replaced it.
Pure: duplicates a feature (a completed Photo Nest to another spot) in the returned design.
Pure: fits a feature to the design (size/position correction).
Turns Inventory tracking on/off for a folder (writes metadata) and returns folder state.

Creates (if missing) and opens the default 'No Defined Space' design folder under the Space root: writes Design metadata when newly created, proves the folder writable, remembers it, and returns its state; a newly created folder is removed again on failure.
Opens and remembers an already-set-up folder (recent/registry/active preferences); refuses folders that still need Space setup.

Generates the bin's 3MF set under export_printer_profile and returns build_timings_ms; local mode writes files into output (auto_timestamp/keep_log control naming and Inventory logging) and may append an Inventory row/design spec.
HOSTED mode builds in an isolated temp workspace and replies files:[{name,url}] with one-time /api/export tokens (retired; replaced by local Blob file IDs).
Entry-guarded, printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent per operation_id.
Read-only: reports build/runtime identity (version, instance, api_compat, build, commit, branch, source fingerprint, launch token).
GET only; the UI calls it with api(path) (no payload) to detect a different running instance.
Pure: grows the design box/layout to fit; returns design, box, grew, changed.
Entry-guarded: _checked_entry_payload verifies destination grid ownership before the handler runs.
Pure: switches the design's layout mode and returns the design.
Pure: finalizes (create/update) a Photo Nest feature from an already traced contour in the returned design.
Pure: re-tunes an already rectified reference sheet (sensitivity/cleanup) without repeating paper detection.
Pure image work: paper detection/correction and contour trace of an uploaded photo (no file written).
Read-only: looks up the in-memory operation ledger entry for one operation_id; never runs or retries work.
Returns operation_status unknown | running (elapsed_s, progress) | done (result) | error (error).
Generates N printable Pegboard hooks (standard|skadis) into one 3MF named 'Pegboard hooks - <standard> x<count>.3mf' in output (HOSTED: temp workspace + export token).
Idempotent per operation_id.
Pure: per-bin pegboard layout for standard/bins; a failing bin yields {error, compatible:false} under its id.

Local: validates then persists output, slicer_path, base_trim_bed_x_mm/y_mm, connector_settings (range-checked; written to the Wavefinity folder's connector settings file when one exists, else preferences) and returns the served preferences.
HOSTED mode returns {preferences:{}} and writes nothing.
Builds preview geometry (bin, Base Trim, B4B, structural) under the geometry lock; registers the request token so a newer client_id/generation supersedes it, returning {superseded:true}.
Writes nothing; build_timings_ms reports per-stage time.
Raises ValueError in HOSTED mode (the native/server operation is unavailable there).

Local: preflights slicer path (detect_bambu_studio) before any file is written; target bin|all|connector|sampler|base_trim_joint_test; generates (auto_timestamp) or reuses the Printed file (reuse_printed_file); checks files exist/non-empty and fit the active printer; launches the slicer once with all files.
Partial results (files kept, slicer failed) come back as partial/partial_stage/error. Entry-guarded, printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent per operation_id.
Generates the fit-sampler 3MF ('Wavefinity fit sampler.3mf') in output (HOSTED: temp workspace + export token) under the geometry lock.
Explain browser diagnostics and chosen-folder Inventory; no server log or desktop launch.
Native directory chooser for the Space storage parent; with pick_only returns the chosen parent without saving.
Otherwise saves space_parent in preferences (refused with 'Use Change Location' when the Wavefinity root already exists). Cancel returns {folder:null, storage}.
Raises ValueError in HOSTED mode (the native/server operation is unavailable there).
Configures an existing folder/legacy Inventory as a typed Space (migration path, allows legacy box); writes metadata/layout and remembers it.
Pure over supplied Inventory text: hosted Configure/migration (allow_legacy); returns inventory text/layout.

Copies the open Space (space_id must match; must sit directly inside the Space root; links refused) to a uniquely named sibling with a new Space ID and name via shutil.copytree, rewrites copied metadata/Inventory layout.space, registers it, and removes the partial copy on failure. Caller: SP.runSpaceAction('copy') via a dynamic /api/space/${action} path.
Pure: picks a unique duplicate name from names[] and name; names must be a list.
Pure: renames the copied Space inside the supplied inventory_text (name 1-80 chars, requires a saved layout.space); returns {inventory_text}.

Creates a new typed Space: validates the definition, creates the folder (under the Space root when output is omitted), writes Space metadata and an Inventory layout, remembers it; returns remember_warning when remembering fails.
Pure over supplied Inventory text: hosted equivalent of Create; returns the new inventory text/layout; never accepts legacy 'box'.
Writes keep_bin_defaults/bin_defaults/part_defaults to the Space metadata (space_id must match when given) and returns folder state.

Deletes (shutil.rmtree) the identified Space folder after checks (must be the open Space, space_id matching, directly inside the Space root), then forgets it from registry/recents/active and clears preferences.output if it pointed there; returns the forget() state. Caller: SP.runSpaceAction('delete') via a dynamic /api/space/${action} path.
Removes a Space/folder from the registry and recents (by space_id and/or output) without deleting files; returns folder state.
Read-only describe of one folder: Space/Design mode, metadata, inventory presence, setup needs and resume state; never migrates or rewrites.
Inline lambda: calls set_inventory({**payload, 'inventory': False}); forces Inventory tracking off.
Same handler as /api/folder/use: open and remember a set-up folder without changing it.
Read-only: lists registered Spaces other than the active one (missing/invalid/conflict flagged).
No profile and no reset: reads the saved printer profile state. profile: validates and saves printer keys to preferences. reset:true: clears only the printer-profile keys.
Persists resume_design/resume_pending in Space metadata (checks space_id); entry-guarded so a resumed design must pass the destination-grid check.
Opens the OS file explorer on preferences.output (os.startfile/open/xdg-open); returns {ok:true}.
Raises ValueError in HOSTED mode (the native/server operation is unavailable there).
Reads the saved preference, not the request payload; errors if no folder set or folder missing.

Recovers any interrupted relocation, resolves the active Space from preferences (repairing a moved folder path), opens/remembers it when set up, and returns Welcome state with recent, storage and other_spaces.
Writes preferences only to repair a moved registered folder or remember the opened Space.
Preflight then one case + placed-bin + connector handoff to the slicer (_combined_space_print); marks printed rows. Raises in HOSTED mode. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Change Location: mode Move existing data / Use new location / Use existing; may move the Wavefinity root and update preferences; returns status, leftover, storage, root.
Local cabinet mutation (operation on drawer_id/space) applied to the verified Space folder's metadata/Inventory (space_id must match). Idempotent.
Hosted twin of the cabinet mutation: pure over the supplied Inventory text; returns the mutated space. Idempotent.
Pure: what Reset cabinet settings would leave, plus why it is needed. Idempotent.
Read-only cabinet summary for a draft/saved Storage Drawers Space (requires space object).
Pure: canonical normalizer over a raw Storage Drawers Space.
Validates and saves the Space storage parent in preferences; returns {storage}.
Read-only plan for moving/switching the Space storage parent.
Read-only: current Space storage location state.
Read-only: derives a Space's structural design (Storage Box, Base Trim, cabinet) and plain size summary; never touches an Inventory.
Saves a Space's Storage Box, Base Trim or cabinet files (local: verified Space folder, never logs an Inventory row; HOSTED: temp + export token). Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.

Sends a Space's Storage Box, Base Trim or cabinet to the slicer after generation or reuse (reuse_printed_file); never logs an Inventory row. Raises in HOSTED mode. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Print Cabinet + Bins: cabinet and every placed bin under one preflight and one slicer launch. Raises in HOSTED mode. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Preflight then one Base Trim + placed-bin + connector handoff to the slicer (_combined_space_print); marks printed rows. Raises in HOSTED mode. Printer-profile-wrapped, idempotent.
Updates an existing Space definition (kind fixed; Space grid immutable); rewrites Space metadata/layout and refreshes recents.
Creates the folder if needed and, for a non-Space folder, writes Design metadata (never demotes a typed Space or a Space needing setup), then remembers it.
Local: starts one daemon thread that pre-builds previews for listed/recent Spaces (read-only, writes nothing, never opens or remembers a Space); returns {started}.
HOSTED mode (or already running / nothing to warm) returns {started:false}.
Prepare local report text; UI downloads it as a Blob. Nothing is posted online.
